meanings.tr: hisse, sahip olunan varlık (özellikle hisse senedi veya arazi)
meanings.en: something owned, especially shares or land
meanings.exampleEn: Her holding in the company increased after she bought more shares.
meanings.exampleTr: Daha fazla hisse aldıktan sonra şirketteki hissesi arttı.

meanings.en: business expenses that do not change with output
meanings.exampleEn: Rent and salaries are typical fixed costs for a small business.
meanings.exampleTr: Kira ve maaşlar küçük bir işletme için tipik sabit maliyetlerdir.

meanings.en: the process of obtaining goods or materials
meanings.exampleEn: The company improved its sourcing of raw materials from local suppliers.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, ham madde tedarikini yerel tedarikçilerden iyileştirdi.

meanings.en: the act of buying goods or services
meanings.exampleEn: The purchasing department handles all orders for office supplies.
meanings.exampleTr: Satın alma departmanı tüm ofis malzemesi siparişlerini yönetir.

meanings.en: the activities involved in running a business
meanings.exampleEn: The company expanded its operations into three new countries.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket faaliyetlerini üç yeni ülkeye genişletti.

meanings.en: a place for storing goods or vehicles
meanings.exampleEn: The trucks return to the depot at the end of each day.
meanings.exampleTr: Kamyonlar her günün sonunda depoya geri döner.

meanings.en: a large quantity or mass
meanings.exampleEn: Buying in bulk is cheaper than buying small amounts.
meanings.exampleTr: Toptan almak az miktarda almaktan daha ucuzdur.

meanings.en: a person or company that supplies something
meanings.exampleEn: We switched to a new internet provider last month.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen ay yeni bir internet sağlayıcısına geçtik.

meanings.en: repayment of money that someone has spent
meanings.exampleEn: Employees can claim reimbursement for travel expenses.
meanings.exampleTr: Çalışanlar seyahat masrafları için geri ödeme talep edebilir.

meanings.en: a reduction in the price of something
meanings.exampleEn: The store offered a 30% markdown on winter coats.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağaza kışlık montlarda yüzde 30 fiyat indirimi sundu.

meanings.en: regular costs that stay the same over time
meanings.exampleEn: Our fixed expenses include rent, insurance, and utilities.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabit giderlerimiz kira, sigorta ve faturaları içerir.

meanings.en: able to be made larger in size or scope
meanings.exampleEn: The suitcase has an expandable section for extra luggage.
meanings.exampleTr: Bavulun ekstra eşya için genişletilebilir bir bölmesi var.

meanings.en: unable to be maintained or continued over time
meanings.exampleEn: The current level of spending is completely unsustainable.
meanings.exampleTr: Mevcut harcama düzeyi tamamen sürdürülemez.

meanings.en: capable of being done or used successfully
meanings.exampleEn: We finally found a workable solution to the problem.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonunda soruna uygulanabilir bir çözüm bulduk.

meanings.en: not capable of working or succeeding
meanings.exampleEn: The project became unviable once costs doubled.
meanings.exampleTr: Maliyetler ikiye katlanınca proje uygulanamaz hale geldi.

meanings.en: something that discourages an action
meanings.exampleEn: High fines act as a deterrent to careless driving.
meanings.exampleTr: Yüksek cezalar dikkatsiz sürüş için caydırıcı bir unsur olarak işlev görür.

meanings.en: an extra benefit given with a job
meanings.exampleEn: Free gym membership is one of the perks of this job.
meanings.exampleTr: Ücretsiz spor salonu üyeliği bu işin yan haklarından biridir.

meanings.en: additional time worked beyond normal hours
meanings.exampleEn: She worked extra hours to finish the report on time.
meanings.exampleTr: Raporu zamanında bitirmek için fazla mesai yaptı.

meanings.en: to obtain help or join the armed forces
meanings.exampleEn: They enlisted the support of local volunteers.
meanings.exampleTr: Yerel gönüllülerin desteğine başvurdular.

meanings.en: to leave a job or stop doing something
meanings.exampleEn: He decided to quit his job and start a business.
meanings.exampleTr: İşinden istifa edip bir iş kurmaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: to leave an important position or job
meanings.exampleEn: The CEO will step down at the end of the year.
meanings.exampleTr: Genel müdür yıl sonunda görevinden çekilecek.

meanings.en: to raise to a higher level or position
meanings.exampleEn: The promotion will elevate her to a senior role.
meanings.exampleTr: Terfi onu üst düzey bir göreve yükseltecek.

meanings.en: to reduce to a lower level or rank
meanings.exampleEn: The agency downgraded the country's credit rating.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuruluş ülkenin kredi notunu düşürdü.

meanings.en: a standard used to measure or judge something
meanings.exampleEn: Profit is not the only yardstick of success.
meanings.exampleTr: Kâr, başarının tek ölçütü değildir.

meanings.en: an important event or a notable building
meanings.exampleEn: The new law was a landmark in workers' rights.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasa işçi hakları açısından bir dönüm noktasıydı.

meanings.en: behavior in line with rules or standards
meanings.exampleEn: The products must be tested for conformity with safety rules.
meanings.exampleTr: Ürünler güvenlik kurallarına uygunluk açısından test edilmelidir.

meanings.en: an action that breaks a rule or law
meanings.exampleEn: Parking here is a violation of the traffic rules.
meanings.exampleTr: Buraya park etmek trafik kurallarının ihlalidir.

meanings.en: a company connected to a larger one
meanings.exampleEn: The bank operates through several local affiliates.
meanings.exampleTr: Banka birkaç yerel iştirak aracılığıyla faaliyet gösterir.

meanings.en: a company that controls other companies
meanings.exampleEn: The parent company owns several smaller brands.
meanings.exampleTr: Ana şirket birkaç küçük markaya sahiptir.

meanings.en: the main office of a company
meanings.exampleEn: All major decisions are made at the head office.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm önemli kararlar genel merkezde alınır.

meanings.en: to close down a business officially
meanings.exampleEn: They decided to wind up the failing company.
meanings.exampleTr: Zarar eden şirketi tasfiye etmeye karar verdiler.

meanings.en: to sell goods or assets, often cheaply
meanings.exampleEn: The firm had to sell off part of its property.
meanings.exampleTr: Firma mülkünün bir kısmını elden çıkarmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: a person or institution that lends money
meanings.exampleEn: The lender charged a high interest rate on the loan.
meanings.exampleTr: Kredi veren, borç için yüksek bir faiz oranı uyguladı.

meanings.en: a person who borrows money
meanings.exampleEn: The borrower must repay the loan within five years.
meanings.exampleTr: Borç alan, krediyi beş yıl içinde geri ödemelidir.

meanings.en: money borrowed to buy a house
meanings.exampleEn: They took out a home loan to buy their first house.
meanings.exampleTr: İlk evlerini almak için bir konut kredisi çektiler.

meanings.en: to value someone or something too low
meanings.exampleEn: People often underrate the importance of good sleep.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsanlar iyi uykunun önemini sıklıkla hafife alır.

meanings.en: the act of giving out resources for a purpose
meanings.exampleEn: The allocation of funds to each department was fair.
meanings.exampleTr: Fonların her departmana tahsisi adildi.

meanings.en: to improve something by small changes
meanings.exampleEn: We need to refine the design before production.
meanings.exampleTr: Üretimden önce tasarımı iyileştirmemiz gerekiyor.

meanings.en: to give someone responsibility for something
meanings.exampleEn: She entrusted the project to her best manager.
meanings.exampleTr: Projeyi en iyi yöneticisine emanet etti.

meanings.en: to bring control into one central place
meanings.exampleEn: The company decided to centralize its purchasing operations.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket satın alma operasyonlarını merkezileştirmeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: to control something too much
meanings.exampleEn: Managers who overcontrol their teams reduce creativity.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekiplerini aşırı kontrol eden yöneticiler yaratıcılığı azaltır.

meanings.en: a period for testing before a final decision
meanings.exampleEn: New employees have a three-month trial period.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni çalışanların üç aylık bir deneme süresi vardır.

meanings.en: to charge someone too much money
meanings.exampleEn: The shop overcharged me for the repair.
meanings.exampleTr: Dükkân tamir için benden fazla ücret aldı.

meanings.en: to set a price too low for something
meanings.exampleEn: They underpriced the product and lost money.
meanings.exampleTr: Ürünü düşük fiyatlandırdılar ve para kaybettiler.

meanings.en: not yet paid, or without payment
meanings.exampleEn: She took an unpaid leave to care for her family.
meanings.exampleTr: Ailesine bakmak için ücretsiz izin aldı.

meanings.en: paid in full or finally resolved
meanings.exampleEn: All the invoices are now settled.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm faturalar artık ödenmiştir.

meanings.en: having too few workers
meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant was short-staffed on the weekend.
meanings.exampleTr: Restoran hafta sonu personel sıkıntısı çekiyordu.

meanings.en: the process of introducing someone to a new job
meanings.exampleEn: All new staff attend an induction on their first day.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm yeni personel ilk günlerinde işe alıştırma eğitimine katılır.

meanings.en: the process of an employee leaving a company
meanings.exampleEn: The offboarding process includes returning all equipment.
meanings.exampleTr: İşten çıkış süreci tüm ekipmanın iadesini içerir.

meanings.en: a gradual reduction in staff numbers
meanings.exampleEn: The company reduced its workforce through natural attrition.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket iş gücünü doğal personel kaybı yoluyla azalttı.

meanings.en: to reduce the amount of something
meanings.exampleEn: The firm had to cut back on advertising spending.
meanings.exampleTr: Firma reklam harcamalarını kısmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: to recover after a fall or decline
meanings.exampleEn: The economy began to rebound after the recession.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekonomi durgunluğun ardından toparlanmaya başladı.

meanings.en: a decline in business or economic activity
meanings.exampleEn: Many shops closed during the economic downturn.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekonomik gerileme sırasında birçok dükkân kapandı.

meanings.en: to improve or update something significantly
meanings.exampleEn: The company plans to revamp its website next year.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket gelecek yıl web sitesini elden geçirmeyi planlıyor.

meanings.en: a situation in which something is necessary
meanings.exampleEn: There is a growing need for skilled workers.
meanings.exampleTr: Nitelikli işçilere giderek artan bir ihtiyaç var.

meanings.en: an amount of something available for use
meanings.exampleEn: The supply of fresh water is limited in the region.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölgede temiz su arzı sınırlıdır.

meanings.en: an amount by which something falls short
meanings.exampleEn: There was a shortfall in the company's annual budget.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin yıllık bütçesinde bir açık vardı.

meanings.en: a way of earning money
meanings.exampleEn: Renting out the flat became her main income source.
meanings.exampleTr: Daireyi kiraya vermek onun ana gelir kaynağı oldu.

meanings.en: an improvement in business or the economy
meanings.exampleEn: Sales rose during the recent upturn in the market.
meanings.exampleTr: Piyasadaki son yükseliş sırasında satışlar arttı.

meanings.en: a sudden fall in prices, sales or activity
meanings.exampleEn: The company faced a slump in sales last quarter.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket geçen çeyrekte satışlarda bir düşüşle karşılaştı.

meanings.en: the state of being unsteady or likely to change
meanings.exampleEn: Political instability scared away foreign investors.
meanings.exampleTr: Siyasi istikrarsızlık yabancı yatırımcıları korkutup kaçırdı.

meanings.en: the quality of being firm and constant
meanings.exampleEn: Investors valued the steadiness of the firm's profits.
meanings.exampleTr: Yatırımcılar firmanın kârlarındaki istikrara değer verdi.

meanings.en: money that must be accepted as payment
meanings.exampleEn: The old coins are no longer legal tender.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski madeni paralar artık resmi ödeme aracı değildir.

meanings.en: a rapid rise in prices that cannot last
meanings.exampleEn: The housing market showed signs of a price bubble.
meanings.exampleTr: Konut piyasası bir fiyat balonu belirtileri gösterdi.

meanings.en: reductions in spending or staff
meanings.exampleEn: The cutbacks led to several job losses.
meanings.exampleTr: Kesintiler birkaç iş kaybına yol açtı.

meanings.en: advantages or extra payments from a job
meanings.exampleEn: The job offers good benefits, including health insurance.
meanings.exampleTr: İş, sağlık sigortası dahil iyi yan haklar sunuyor.

meanings.en: a large amount of money and possessions
meanings.exampleEn: He dreamed of fame and riches.
meanings.exampleTr: Şöhret ve servet hayali kuruyordu.

meanings.en: the state of having a lot of money
meanings.exampleEn: The neighborhood is a sign of growing affluence.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu mahalle artan refahın bir işaretidir.

meanings.en: a great difference between things
meanings.exampleEn: There is a wide disparity in income between regions.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölgeler arasında gelir konusunda büyük bir eşitsizlik var.

meanings.en: to save something for a particular purpose
meanings.exampleEn: They set aside some money for emergencies.
meanings.exampleTr: Acil durumlar için biraz para bir kenara ayırdılar.
